items.question: Where did Jordin Canada play college basketball?
items.answer: Jordin Canada played at UCLA. The WNBA says she is UCLA women's basketball's all-time assists leader with 831 and was a two-time Pac-12 Defensive Player of the Year.

items.question: Has Jordin Canada led the WNBA in steals?
items.answer: Yes. The WNBA lists her as the league's steals leader in 2019 and 2023, and she made the All-Defensive First Team both years.
